blocks.text: The party made landfall in [[Port Vellen]] on a fog-bound evening and paid [[Dockmaster Hobb Merrin]]'s berth fee with their last honest coin. [[One-Lantern Sef]] sold them two rumors: that [[Kestrel Vane]] pays triple for anything fished out of the drowned quarter, and that [[Brother Aldous]] has stopped lighting the western lamps.

Kass took a job from the [[The Tidewardens|Tidewardens]] without telling the others. The party sleeps at the Tavern; the bells of the Lantern Shrine ring a quarter past every hour — one ring short of what [[Ilsa Corvin]]'s curfew notice says they should.

Next session: the Hand's watcher on the fish market steps has marked the party. If they visit Sef again, he's gone — lantern still burning. Session logs mentioning an entry show up in its backlinks, so every NPC's page now lists this session automatically.
